messages:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — dep chain blocking the SDK release. SDK PR #432 (sdk-js) is ready but depends on API PR #987 and console PR #210. Also a helm/runtime tweak in runtime/helm PR #56 looks like it may break e2e. Need merge ordering + canary plan. Who can own sequencing?
Priya: which tests are failing right now? e2e or unit? can we short-circuit with a fallback in the SDK? :thinking_face:
Ethan: e2e failing after runtime/helm #56 linting + chart changes; API PR #987 introduces an auth header rename (minor) so SDK needs a compat layer. Unit tests for SDK pass.
Sam: I can take console + backend review once API is stable. For merge timing — tomorrow morning window 10:00-11:30 PT works for me.
Priya: the auth header rename is causing integration tests to 401. quick patch suggestion in SDK: check for both headers for a release cycle, e.g.:
```js
const auth = req.headers['x-new-auth'] || req.headers['x-auth'];
```
Morgan: suggested sequence: 1) merge API #987 -> run smoke tests, 2) merge runtime/helm #56 and run cluster lint + e2e smoke, 3) merge console #210, 4) then merge SDK #432 and cut new minor. Need someone to coordinate the train (and hold a merge PR list).
Ethan: I can coordinate the train. I'll hold a merge checklist and call out each step in thread. Need explicit LGTM from @Security and @Ops on API header change, and @QA for canary plan.
DevOps Bot: CI statuses: API #987 — all checks passed except security scan (pending). runtime/helm #56 — lint failed (helm-lint). console #210 — integration tests queued. SDK #432 — all checks green locally, CI pending.
QA: happy to run the canary watch. propose canary traffic: 10% for 30m, then 50% for 30m, then punch to 100% if no regressions. I'll monitor errors, latency, and token cost metrics.
Sam: plan looks good. Quick rollback playbook pointer: revert route in envoy or flip feature flag. Morgan, can you paste the minimal rollback commands?
Morgan: rollback snippets:
```
# revert console route
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/console-deployment
# revert canary traffic
curl -X POST https://console.ops/reconfigure -d '{"route": "stable"}'
```
Also keep the canary tag in telemetry to filter.
Priya: also can we add a changelog note for the header rename and call out SDK compatibility? we should ping partner integrations slack channel post-merge.
Ethan: yes — will add changelog entry and a short note in #partners after successful canary. Also will add a small compatibility unit test to SDK before merge to assert dual-header support.
Sam: I'll take console + SDK final smoke after API is merged. Ethan, can you coordinate merges tomorrow at 10:00 PT? Priya to monitor tests, QA on canary. @Security @Ops please prioritize quick review on API header change.
Security: I'll take a look — can you drop the API PR link here?
Ethan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/987 — added a summary of the auth change and impact matrix in the PR description.
Sam: ok locking this plan. I put a calendar block 10:00-11:30 PT for the merge window. I'll ping in the channel 5 min before start.
Morgan: thanks everyone — appreciate fast turnaround. I'll coordinate the post-merge status update here. :thumbsup: :tada:
